_what: Calendar-year TOTAL RETURNS for every Vanguard Target Retirement fund, taken from the issuer's own summary prospectuses. The ground truth the CONSTRUCTED target-date series is reconciled against by glide_reconcile.mjs. Not shipped to the browser.
_provenance: Summary prospectuses dated 28 January 2026, one per fund, published by Vanguard at personal1.vanguard.com/pub/Pdf/sp<fundnumber>.pdf. Fund numbers: Income 308, 2020 682, 2025 304, 2030 695, 2035 305, 2040 696, 2045 306, 2050 699, 2055 1487, 2060 1691, 2065 1791.
The same documents are filed with the SEC as form 497K on 2026-01-28 under Vanguard Chester Funds, CIK 0000752177 — accessions 0001193125-26-024997 through 0001193125-26-025011.

Figures are the prospectus 'Annual Total Returns' bar chart, which the Investment Company Act risk/return taxonomy defines as total return with distributions reinvested, net of the fund's own expenses. Ten calendar years per fund, 2016-2025; the 2065 fund launched in 2017 so it has eight.

Cross-check on the one series that also exists as monthly data in benchmarks.json: the shipped real TARGET_2060 monthly returns compound onto these 2060 figures to within 6bp in every full calendar year. That is the market-price-versus-NAV difference, and it bounds how tightly anything else can be expected to reconcile.
expenseRatio is 'Total Annual Fund Operating Expenses' from the same document, as a fraction.
